pull.title: feat(tools): census and gate of the SysML v2 graphical notation (§8.2.3)
pull.body:
## What and why

The view renderers (`internal/ir/view`, the VS Code canvas) had no measure of how much of the SysML v2 **graphical** notation they draw. This adds the same kind of census and gate the textual grammar (`tools/census/grammar`) and the v1→v2 mapping (`tools/census/transformation`) have, for clause §8.2.3 "Graphical Notation" of the pinned SysML v2.1 Beta 2 specification:

- `tools/census/notation` + `tools/cmd/notation-census`: `Extract` reads the graphical BNF (`name =` / `name =|` statements under the `8.2.3.n` headings) out of `build/spec-docs/sysml.txt`, handling the `pdftotext -layout` artifacts explicitly (form-feed-prefixed headings and statements, page footers in right-hand sides). It is strict: 27 headings in order, no production in the overview, at least one in every other clause, and a production without a verdict (or a verdict for a production the clause no longer states) is an error, so a text from another pin fails loudly. The full extraction finds **620 statements naming 523 distinct productions** (the brief's 503 was the count without the form-feed-prefixed lines); one census row is one distinct production.
- Every production is categorised (node, compartment, edge, label, view, textual) and adjudicated `drawn` / `approximate` / `undrawn` / `not-applicable`, with `file:function`, forms and test/golden evidence that `-check` resolves against the Go/TypeScript sources and `testdata/`. The 31 edge rows reuse the notation table of `docs/project/view-rendering-forms.md` rather than restating it.
- `-measure` rewrites `docs/project/graphical-notation-census-baseline.json` (source pin, totals, per-clause and per-category counts, every non-drawn row with its reason and work package) and the generated blocks of `docs/project/graphical-notation-census.md`; the full table with each row's evidence goes to `build/graphical-notation-census/rows.md`. `-check` verifies the baseline, the pin, the document, the citations and — where the text is present or required — a fresh measurement.
- CI: `notation-census -check -require-text` beside the transformation census in the gate job that renders the specification text, and a text-free `-check` in the docs job.

Totals: 523 productions — 199 drawn, 55 approximate, 97 undrawn, 172 not applicable. The gaps are grouped into work packages A–F in the census page. Tooling and docs only: no renderer behaviour changes, nothing removed or renamed (patch material under CONTRIBUTING § Versioning). The gaps are not fixed here.

## How it was verified

- `go test -C tools ./census/notation`: extractor tests over a committed excerpt of the rendered text (`testdata/sysml-8.2.3-productions.txt`, every heading and statement line, 15 KiB, so the tests run without the PDF) including the rejected mutations; classifier and notation-table tests; evidence-citation tests; and a measure/check round trip in a staged root that re-measures over the excerpt and expects the committed baseline and document byte for byte, plus the drift, stale-document, changed-text, absent-text, pin-change and broken-citation failures the gate must catch.
- `go run -C tools ./cmd/notation-census -check -require-text` over the freshly downloaded `build/spec-docs/sysml.txt`.
- Verdicts were taken by reading the writers and goldens and by rendering fixtures that declare every definition and usage kind, both as nodes and as members of a positioned node (compartments).
- `gofmt -l .` empty, `go vet ./...`, `make lint`, `go test ./tests/hygiene`, `python3 scripts/check-doc-links.py`, `python -m mkdocs build --strict`, `python3 scripts/changelog.py check`.

## Checklist

- [x] `make test` and `make lint` pass locally
- [x] Tests added or updated for the change
- [x] Documentation extended where it already covers the surface (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Changelog entry added as `changes/unreleased/<slug>.<section>.md`, not as an edit to `CHANGELOG.md`
- [x] baselines regenerated and `make docs-counts` run if a gate count moved (compliance rows need nothing: the census is counted at docs build)
- [x] No internal work-item labels (waves, slices, `F4`, `K5`) in the body, docs, or changelog

commit.message:
feat(tools): census and gate of the SysML v2 graphical notation (§8.2.3)

tools/census/notation extracts the 523 productions of clause 8.2.3 from the
pinned specification text, adjudicates each against the view renderers with
code and golden evidence, and holds the committed baseline and census page to
the measurement; notation-census -check runs in CI beside the transformation
census.

Co-Authored-By: jason.han <hanhuijun@gmail.com>

fix(tools): notation census rejects unreviewed compartment productions and unknown table statuses

Every compartment-contents/element production is adjudicated by name, so a
production new to the specification fails rather than passing as textual,
and the notation table's status cell must be conformant, approximate or
differs from pilot.

Co-Authored-By: jason.han <hanhuijun@gmail.com>
